summary: Orion Koleis, 45, fell head-down into a tree well on Upper Canaan below Paradise Bowl at Crested Butte Mountain Resort, pinned upside-down and suffocating; fellow skiers dug him out and performed CPR until ski patrol arrived; patrol administered a nasal airway and hauled him to the clinic, and Crested Butte Fire Protection District EMTs transported him to Gunnison Valley Hospital, released the next day.
location: Upper Canaan below Paradise Bowl, Crested Butte Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Resort ski patrol; Crested Butte Fire Protection District
notes: In-bounds incident INCLUDED: ski patrol + CBFPD EMS response documented (run-999 Keystone distinction - no SAR/patrol response described there). Run 1017 chunk C.
